info.name: SwiftDrop API Tests
info.description: Controller-derived API contract tests for feature/janani-final-tasks. See postman/README.md. Default environment contains no credentials. Writes, outbound retries, and email/Google flows are gated. Skipped requests are not passes. No response examples or signing secrets are saved.
